scripts/mutation_gate.py:141: `if mode is None:` then raises GateError — untested
scripts/mutation_gate.py:138: `except ValueError as exc:` raising GateError for an unrecognized mode string — untested
Only new test: tests/scripts/test_mutation_gate.py:50 asserts `all(shard.mode is gate.EnforcementMode.ADVISORY ...)`

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Rename the loop variable at line 139 from `mode` to `member` to match line 142 and avoid shadowing the outer `mode`.
advisory.finding: At line 139 the generator expression reuses the identifier `mode` (`", ".join(mode.value for mode in EnforcementMode)`), shadowing the outer `mode` variable being assigned in the surrounding block; line 142 uses the clearer name `member` for the identical construct. Functionally safe due to Python 3 comprehension scoping, but the inconsistency reduces clarity.
advisory.suggested_fix: Change line 139 to `allowed = ", ".join(member.value for member in EnforcementMode)`.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add tests asserting load_manifest raises GateError for an invalid `mode` string, a non-string `mode`, and a missing `mode`.
evidence: scripts/mutation_gate.py:137-143 add three GateError branches: `mode = EnforcementMode(mode_value) if isinstance(mode_value, str) else None`, the `except ValueError` branch, and the `if mode is None` branch
search of tests/scripts/test_mutation_gate.py for `GateError` returns `(no matches)` and for `raises` returns `(no matches)` — no test exercises any manifest rejection path
The only new mode test (tests/scripts/test_mutation_gate.py:46-50) asserts the happy path (all shards ADVISORY); the invalid-mode, non-string-mode, and missing-mode paths have no coverage
Because `mode` has no default, a missing `mode` now raises GateError — this newly-required-field behavior is regression-blind without a test
advisory.finding: The new mode-validation rejection branches (invalid enum string, non-string value, missing value) added in load_manifest are untested; no test asserts that an invalid or missing `mode` raises GateError, so a regression in this new validation would go undetected.
scenarios: A future edit removes the `except ValueError`/`is None` guard, letting an invalid or absent mode slip through with no test failure
A shard added to the manifest without a `mode` key would now fail load, but nothing verifies this contract
advisory.suggested_fix: Add table-driven tests writing a temp manifest with mode omitted, mode = "bogus", and mode = 3, each wrapped in `with pytest.raises(gate.GateError)`, asserting the message names the allowed modes.
